ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: chronomancer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Chronomancers see time as a river they can wade into. They hasten friends, slow foes, rewind wounds, blink across the battlefield and, at the peak of their art, stop time itself.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Bend time and space. Haste allies, slow enemies, stop the clock entirely.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'I have seen how this fight ends,' she said. 'Shall we skip to that part?'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Control and force multiplication. Haste your best fighters, Slow and Time Stop enemies, and Rewind injuries. Wants Celerity and Attunement - cooldown reduction is king.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: timeweaver
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Timeweavers stitch moments together. Their allies move at impossible speed while enemies wither into dust.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Mass haste, temporal prisons, youth and age. The ultimate force multiplier.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The Timeweaver of Gallow Rise is three hundred years old. She looks twenty-five. She will not tell you how.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Support a whole squad: Mass Haste, Echo of Moments to reset everyone's cooldowns, and Eternity to win any fight. Wants Celerity and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: voidwalker
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Voidwalkers learned that space has holes in it. They step through, pull enemies in, and drop what remains into nothing.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Walk between worlds. Portals, gravity wells and the devouring Singularity.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Where do they go?' 'Nowhere. That's rather the point.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Positioning and raw destruction. Gravity Well gathers enemies, Void Bolt tears through armor, and Singularity erases whatever is left. Wants Potency and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: paradox
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Paradox mages exploit contradictions in time. They undo what already happened, trap foes in loops and erase the unworthy from history.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Break causality. Undo deaths, loop enemies in time and erase them from history.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: She was never here. You will forget this sentence.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Undo mistakes and erase threats. Undo can revive the recently dead; Causality Loop shreds anything; Grandfather Paradox ends bosses. Wants Attunement and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: precognition
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You saw that bullet coming. Sometimes you step aside before it's fired.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: recursion
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Sometimes a spell happens twice: once now and once a moment from now, and its cooldown is refunded.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: dilation
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Time drags near you. Nearby enemies are slowed.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: eternal stasis
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When you stop time, it stays stopped. Time Stop and Slow last half again as long and reach further.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: infinite acceleration
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything you do happens a little sooner than it should.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: master of time
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When badly hurt, time sometimes simply undoes it: a free Rewind Wounds on yourself.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: centenarian
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Senescence ages harder and Rejuvenate restores more years; both return sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: temporal prison
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Time spells usually slow their targets.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: momentum
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Casting time spells briefly hastens you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: loom of fate
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every effect you weave lasts far longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: accelerando
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Allies near you in combat are permanently hastened.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: devourer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The void is always hungry. Void kills implode, hurting nearby foes and feeding you mana.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: annihilation
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Pure erasure. Void spells deal vastly more damage and ignore much more armor.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: butterfly effect
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Small changes, big consequences: time spells sometimes loop a random enemy for free.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: erasure
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: All your spells erase the badly wounded from history, and Grandfather Paradox returns much sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: ouroboros
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When you fall, time rewinds to just before. Once per day.

AbilityDef.label: temporal bolt
AbilityDef.description: A bolt of raw entropy. Ignores armor completely and may slow the target.

AbilityDef.label: haste
AbilityDef.description: Speed up an ally's personal time: faster movement, attacks, casting and work.

AbilityDef.label: slow
AbilityDef.description: Thicken time in an area. Enemies inside crawl.

AbilityDef.label: blink
AbilityDef.description: Step through space to a nearby point.

AbilityDef.label: rewind wounds
AbilityDef.description: Turn back an ally's body by an hour. Every wound received in that time simply never happened.

AbilityDef.label: accelerate growth
AbilityDef.description: Fast-forward time for the plants in an area. Crops leap toward harvest.

AbilityDef.label: chronal shield
AbilityDef.description: Wrap an ally in slowed time; incoming harm loses much of its force.

AbilityDef.label: time stop
AbilityDef.description: Stop time for every enemy around you for six seconds.

AbilityDef.label: rejuvenate
AbilityDef.description: Unwind an ally's personal time. Each casting takes three years off their body, cures one age-related condition (bad back, cataracts, frailty, dementia and the like) and fades one scar. Keep casting to restore them fully.

AbilityDef.label: senescence
AbilityDef.description: Force years of age onto a target in an instant. Each casting adds about eight years, wracks the body with time-ravaged weakness, and may bring on the ailments of old age. Push someone far enough past their natural lifespan and they crumble to dust.

AbilityDef.label: reverse entropy
AbilityDef.description: Run time backwards for everything in an area: damaged items are repaired, spoiled food is fresh again, and clothes taken from the dead lose their taint. Allies' worn gear is restored too.

AbilityDef.label: mass haste
AbilityDef.description: Every ally around you is hastened.

AbilityDef.label: ages of dust
AbilityDef.description: Age everything in an area by years in a heartbeat. Enemies take damage that ignores armor, wither, suffer the ailments of old age, and the very old crumble to dust.

AbilityDef.label: echo of moments
AbilityDef.description: Rewind the cooldowns of every ally nearby. Their spells and abilities are ready again.

AbilityDef.label: fountain of youth
AbilityDef.description: Open a fountain of youth around an ally. Everyone touched loses two years, sheds an age-related condition and a scar, and regrows a lost limb or organ. Repeated castings can restore even the oldest body.

AbilityDef.label: eternity
AbilityDef.description: Stop time across an enormous area for ten seconds. Your allies are hastened, their cooldowns reset, and only they move.

AbilityDef.label: void bolt
AbilityDef.description: A sphere of nothing that tears through armor and leaves reality frayed around its target.

AbilityDef.label: recall
AbilityDef.description: Open a portal: every ally near the target point is pulled through to your side.

AbilityDef.label: gravity well
AbilityDef.description: Collapse space into a well that drags enemies to its center and crushes them.

AbilityDef.label: phase shift
AbilityDef.description: Slip partly out of reality. Attacks pass through you and you move faster.

AbilityDef.label: singularity
AbilityDef.description: Tear open a black hole. For fifteen seconds it drags everything toward it and grinds it out of existence.

AbilityDef.label: transposition
AbilityDef.description: Fold space so that you and a target trade places instantly. Pull an ally out of danger, or drop an enemy into it.

AbilityDef.label: causality loop
AbilityDef.description: Trap a target in a loop: the same moment of pain repeats over and over.

AbilityDef.label: temporal rift
AbilityDef.description: Rip open a rift where time runs strangely: enemies inside slow and decay while allies inside are hastened.

AbilityDef.label: split timeline
AbilityDef.description: Borrow strength from a timeline where you prepared better: a ward, haste and refreshed cooldowns.

AbilityDef.label: undo
AbilityDef.description: Undo the last six hours for an area: allies' recent wounds vanish and allies who died in that time are restored to life.

AbilityDef.label: grandfather paradox
AbilityDef.description: Erase the target from history. Most creatures simply cease to exist; even titans lose most of their vitality.

AbilityDef.label: fate anchor
AbilityDef.description: Anchor an ally's fate to this moment. If they die within the next four hours, time snaps back and they live, whole and unhurt. Works once.

HediffDef.label: causality loop
HediffDef.description: Caught in a loop: the same wound happens again and again.

HediffDef.label: time-ravaged
HediffDef.description: Decades forced onto the body in moments. Muscles waste, joints seize and the mind fogs. Stacks with each casting.

HediffDef.label: fate anchor
HediffDef.description: This person's fate is anchored. If they die while it lasts, time snaps back and they live.
